title: Miss Maggie's and Father Allen's Globetrotters
summary: He explains his band name and the St. Monica's contest.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: What about Miss Maggie's, what was that? What was that? Miss Maggie's, that's all I remember. I looked this up last week, somebody told me about Miss Maggie's, I thought maybe you played that. I think it may have been a joint.
It could have been a joint. I know Miss Isabel, I know she on Chinatown, couldn't be talking about that. Well who had the band called the Globetrotters here? I did Father Allen's Globetrotters.
And where did that band play?
We played everywhere. That's the one I won the contest back at St. Monica's with. You kept the name for years? Yeah, I still got it, Globetrotters, Father Allen's Globetrotters.
That's the name of my band. I just wanted to check it out to make sure. Yeah that's right.
